cues.en: This is the Global News podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是BBC World Service的《Global News》播客。

cues.en: I'm Nick Miles and in the early hours of Monday the 28th of September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是Nick Miles。现在是9月28日星期一凌晨，以下是主要新闻。

cues.en: Five men are arrested in Britain on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offences.
cues.zh: 英国逮捕5名男子，他们涉嫌犯有爆炸物和恐怖主义罪。

cues.en: This follows reports of suspicious vehicles near an airbase used by the US military.
cues.zh: 此前有人报告，在一处供美军使用的空军基地附近出现可疑车辆。

cues.en: We have an exclusive report from Yemen, where fighting is intensifying.
cues.zh: 我们将播出来自也门的独家报道，那里战斗正在加剧。

cues.en: Iranian-backed Houthis continue to advance on the key city of Taiz.
cues.zh: 伊朗支持的胡塞武装继续向重要城市塔伊兹推进。

cues.en: Politics and sport collide as Ireland's football team beats Israel in a match overshadowed by the Gaza conflict.
cues.zh: 爱尔兰足球队击败以色列，但这场比赛因加沙冲突而蒙上阴影，政治与体育发生碰撞。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, Venezuelans take to the streets demanding the return of opposition leader Maria Corina Machado.
cues.zh: 本期还将关注：委内瑞拉人走上街头，要求反对派领袖玛丽亚·科里娜·马查多回国。

cues.en: Will she ever be allowed back in?
cues.zh: 她究竟能否获准回国？

cues.en: The early days of Route 66 are not a fun story.
cues.zh: 66号公路早期的历史并不美好。

cues.en: Where people really want to talk about it is that post-war the open road represented freedom.
cues.zh: 人们真正想谈的是，战后这条开放公路曾代表自由。

cues.en: And Route 66 just kept reinventing itself.
cues.zh: 而66号公路不断重塑自身。

cues.en: As the famous road celebrates its centenary, we take a ride down memory lane.
cues.zh: 这条著名公路迎来百年之际，我们带你踏上怀旧之旅。

cues.en: Speculation is growing over who was behind an attempted attack on an air force base here in the UK.
cues.zh: 外界越来越猜测，究竟是谁策划了对英国一处空军基地的袭击。

cues.en: The base is also used by the US military.
cues.zh: 该基地也供美军使用。

cues.en: Five men have been arrested on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offences.
cues.zh: 5名男子因涉嫌爆炸物和恐怖主义罪已被逮捕。

cues.en: The arrests followed reports of suspicious vehicles near the base in rural England.
cues.zh: 此前有人报告，在英格兰乡村这处基地附近出现可疑车辆。

cues.en: Earlier this year, the British government gave US warplanes permission to use RAF Fairford.
cues.zh: 今年早些时候，英国政府允许美军战机使用RAF Fairford。

cues.en: It was to be a staging post for strikes on Iran.
cues.zh: 该基地将作为对伊朗发动打击的中转站。

cues.en: Donald Trump praised British police for arresting the five men.
cues.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普称赞英国警方逮捕这5名男子。

cues.en: Working with Britain, it was an amazing job. We had them under investigation.
cues.zh: “与英国合作，这是了不起的工作。我们一直在调查他们。”

cues.en: They were looking to do big damage to our fort.
cues.zh: “他们想重创我们的堡垒。”

cues.en: Working with the British worked out great.
cues.zh: “与英国人合作非常顺利。”

cues.en: It may have been Scotland Yard.
cues.zh: “可能是伦敦警察厅。”

cues.en: I don't know. We worked with a lot of them.
cues.zh: “我不知道。我们和他们中的许多人合作过。”

cues.en: We had them under view for a long time and we got them.
cues.zh: “我们监视他们很长时间，最终抓住了他们。”

cues.en: President Trump claimed the men had been monitored for a long time.
cues.zh: 特朗普总统称这些人曾被长期监视。

cues.en: Local police have said the arrests occurred after a member of the public contacted them.
cues.zh: 当地警方表示，逮捕行动是在一名公众联系他们后发生的。

cues.en: Our diplomatic correspondent James Landale told us more about how this story unfolded.
cues.zh: 我们的外交事务记者James Landale介绍了事件经过。

cues.en: It began with a telephone call to the local police in the early hours of the morning.
cues.zh: 事情始于凌晨，一名司机给当地警方打来电话。

cues.en: A driver passing by saw three vans parked in a strange way and alerted the authorities.
cues.zh: 一名路过的司机看到3辆面包车以奇怪方式停放，于是向当局报警。

cues.en: And then it followed from there.
cues.zh: 随后事情就这样发展下去。

cues.en: It is a global story because this kind of threat against military infrastructure across Europe is now forming a pattern.
cues.zh: 这是一起全球性事件，因为这种针对欧洲各地军事基础设施的威胁正在形成某种模式。

cues.en: The idea is hostile activity spilling out of conflicts around the world.
cues.zh: 这意味着敌对活动从世界各地的冲突中蔓延出来。

cues.en: It reaches European capitals and countries, and even the United States.
cues.zh: 它波及欧洲各国首都和国家，甚至波及美国。

cues.en: The interesting questions are: what was the threat, and where did these men come from?
cues.zh: 有意思的问题是：威胁究竟是什么？这些人来自哪里？

cues.en: At the moment, we don't know an awful lot.
cues.zh: 目前我们有很多事情并不知道。

cues.en: We know that the Iranians have directly threatened the British authorities for allowing the Americans to use the base.
cues.zh: 我们知道，伊朗曾直接威胁英国当局，原因是英国允许美国人使用该基地。

cues.en: There was a formal statement by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Tehran in July making that threat.
cues.zh: 7月，德黑兰外交部发表正式声明，作出了这一威胁。

cues.en: In the last few days, UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband met Iranian Foreign Minister Mr Araghchi and explicitly warned him against hostile activity by foreign states in the UK.
cues.zh: 过去几天，英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德会见伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格齐，并明确警告他不要让外国在英国境内开展敌对活动。

cues.en: He reinforced UK resolve against such threats.
cues.zh: 他重申英国应对这类威胁的决心。

cues.en: The idea of Iran being a potential line of inquiry for this investigation is clear and obvious.
cues.zh: 显然，伊朗是这起调查的一个潜在线索方向。

cues.en: Some people are looking to Moscow.
cues.zh: 一些人将目光投向莫斯科。

cues.en: Russia has been threatening to step up its hybrid activity and attacks against NATO countries.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯一直威胁要加强混合行动，并对北约国家发动袭击。

cues.en: Danish intelligence warned about that only a few days ago.
cues.zh: 丹麦情报部门就在几天前对此发出警告。

cues.en: Germany has formally blamed Russia for a drone attack against Leipzig airport.
cues.zh: 德国已正式指责俄罗斯对莱比锡机场发动无人机袭击。

cues.en: The Russian embassy in London also issued a warning over the summer.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯驻伦敦大使馆今年夏天也发出警告。

cues.en: It warned the UK of an increasingly higher price it would pay for its support for Ukraine.
cues.zh: 大使馆警告英国，支持乌克兰将付出越来越高的代价。

cues.en: That might be a line of inquiry too. James Landale.
cues.zh: 这也可能是一条调查线索。James Landale报道。

cues.en: Earlier this month, Houthi fighters made dramatic advances against government forces,
cues.zh: 本月早些时候，胡塞武装战士对政府军取得了戏剧性的推进，

cues.en: taking control of hundreds of kilometres of Yemen's coastline
cues.zh: 控制了也门数百公里的海岸线，

cues.en: close to the Bab al-Mandab Strait,
cues.zh: 靠近曼德海峡，

cues.en: declaring as it did so a naval blockade for Saudi shipping.
cues.zh: 并宣布对驶往沙特的船只实施海上封锁。

cues.en: That's a huge concern worldwide because Houthi advances
cues.zh: 这在全球引发巨大担忧，因为胡塞武装的推进

cues.en: mean they can threaten the millions of barrels of oil that flow through the strait every day.
cues.zh: 意味着他们能够威胁每天经由这条海峡运输的数百万桶石油。

cues.en: Yemeni government forces are now pushing back.
cues.zh: 也门政府军目前正在反击。

cues.en: Fighting is intensifying around the city of Taiz.
cues.zh: 塔伊兹市周边的战斗正在加剧。

cues.en: Our senior international investigations correspondent, Nawal Al-Maghafi, and her team
cues.zh: 我们的国际调查事务高级记者纳瓦尔·阿尔-马加菲及其团队

cues.en: are the first international news organization to reach Taiz
cues.zh: 是胡塞武装推进以来首个抵达塔伊兹的国际新闻机构，

cues.en: since those Houthi advances.
cues.zh: 自那次胡塞武装推进以来。

cues.en: She travelled with government forces to one of the closest positions to the Houthis.
cues.zh: 她随政府军前往距离胡塞武装最近的阵地之一。

cues.en: Locked and loaded, Yemeni troops are heading for battle,
cues.zh: 也门部队全副武装，正奔赴战场，

cues.en: unsure of whether they'll return.
cues.zh: 不知道自己能否回来。

cues.en: They're taking us with them through the valleys of Taiz.
cues.zh: 他们带着我们穿过塔伊兹的山谷。

cues.en: It's not long before we're confronted with the reality of this war.
cues.zh: 没过多久，我们就面对了这场战争的现实。

cues.en: The sound of artillery echoes from afar, but the threat is very close.
cues.zh: 远处回荡着炮火声，但威胁近在咫尺。

cues.en: Hit the deck, hit the deck. Go, go, go. We can hear a drone above,
cues.zh: 卧倒，卧倒。走，走，走。我们能听到上空有无人机，

cues.en: and we've been told that it's a Houthi drone, so we're just taking cover.
cues.zh: 有人告诉我们那是胡塞武装的无人机，所以我们正在寻找掩护。

cues.en: Go up the pathway there and come straight down to the road to the cars. Okay, come on, pick up, pick up.
cues.zh: 沿那条小路上去，再直走下来，到有车辆的路上。好，来吧，捡起来，捡起来。

cues.en: Go, go, go, go, go.
cues.zh: 走，走，走，走，走。

cues.en: As we're leaving, we came across Ali, who's chosen to stay.
cues.zh: 我们离开时遇到了阿里，他选择留下。

cues.en: He fears what would happen if the Houthis take over, and they're getting close.
cues.zh: 他担心胡塞武装接管这里会发生什么，而他们正越来越近。

cues.en: It's terrifying, but we can't afford to leave our home.
cues.zh: 这很可怕，但我们不能离开家园。

cues.en: Have they ever bombed close to your home?
cues.zh: 他们曾在你家附近轰炸过吗？

cues.en: Yes, the shells fell here down the valley behind the school.
cues.zh: 是的，炮弹落在这里，沿着学校后面的山谷而下。

cues.en: Aren't you afraid that any day they might take this area while you're here?
cues.zh: 你不怕他们随时可能在你还在这里时占领这个地区吗？

cues.en: It's in God's hands.
cues.zh: 一切听凭上帝安排。

cues.en: Nestled in these mountains, the Houthis lie in wait.
cues.zh: 胡塞武装潜伏在这些山中。

cues.en: Their recent capture of Mocha and the Bab al-Mandab Strait has transformed this battle.
cues.zh: 他们最近夺取摩卡和曼德海峡，改变了这场战斗的局势。

cues.en: Now they're pushing inland towards Taiz.
cues.zh: 现在他们正向内陆的塔伊兹推进。

cues.en: If this city falls, their grip on the western coast will be much harder to reverse,
cues.zh: 如果这座城市陷落，他们对西海岸的控制将更难逆转，

cues.en: and this war will be felt far beyond Yemen.
cues.zh: 而这场战争的影响将远远超出也门。

cues.en: The latest fighting has displaced more than 100,000 people to places like the Al-Mune camp.
cues.zh: 最近的战斗已迫使超过十万人流离失所，许多人来到阿尔-穆内营地等地。

cues.en: Around 20 kilometres from the front line, in just 10 days, 200 families arrived.
cues.zh: 距离前线约20公里的地方，仅10天内就有200个家庭抵达。

cues.en: Most of them had been displaced before.
cues.zh: 他们中的大多数此前就曾流离失所。

cues.en: It took Fatima two days to get here from Mokha.
cues.zh: 法蒂玛花了两天才从摩卡来到这里。

cues.en: As the fighting closed in, her sons were forced to make an impossible decision, leaving her behind to save their children.
cues.zh: 随着战火逼近，她的儿子们被迫作出艰难决定，留下她去救自己的孩子。

cues.en: I lost my sons.
cues.zh: 我失去了儿子们。

cues.en: I don't know where they are, and now I'm alone out here in the cold.
cues.zh: 我不知道他们在哪里，现在我独自在这寒冷的地方。

cues.en: The human cost doesn't end there.
cues.zh: 人的代价还不止于此。

cues.en: Racing towards the city, one ambulance after another,
cues.zh: 一辆又一辆救护车飞驰进城，

cues.en: 24 casualties within 24 hours to this hospital alone.
cues.zh: 仅这家医院在24小时内就收治了24名伤亡者。

cues.en: We've just been told that a twelve-year-old girl was brought here two hours ago because she was hit by shrapnel.
cues.zh: 刚有人告诉我们，一名12岁女孩两小时前被送到这里，因为她被弹片击中。

cues.en: This war is costing lives, and it's not just militants; it's civilians too.
cues.zh: 这场战争正在夺走生命，不只是武装人员，平民也一样。

cues.en: Rana lies here alone.
cues.zh: 拉娜独自躺在这里。

cues.en: She was at home when the mortar hit.
cues.zh: 迫击炮击中时，她正在家里。

cues.en: But Yemen's battlefield doesn't have boundaries, and this war has a way of finding those who never chose to be a part of it.
cues.zh: 但也门的战场没有边界，这场战争总能波及那些从未选择参与其中的人。

cues.en: Nawal Al-Maghafi reporting.
cues.zh: 纳瓦尔·阿尔-马加菲报道。

cues.en: Ireland has beaten Israel 3-0 in a hugely controversial UEFA Nations League match that took place in Hungary.
cues.zh: 爱尔兰在匈牙利举行的一场极具争议的欧足联国家联赛中以3比0击败以色列。

cues.en: The game almost didn't go ahead because of opposition to Israel's war in Gaza.
cues.zh: 由于反对以色列在加沙的战争，这场比赛险些无法举行。

cues.en: But after days of intense discussions, most of the Irish football squad agreed to take part.
cues.zh: 但经过数日激烈讨论后，大多数爱尔兰队员同意参赛。

cues.en: The goalkeeper Gavin Bazunu refused to play.
cues.zh: 守门员加文·巴祖努拒绝出场。

cues.en: The rest of the team wore black armbands in honour of the tens of thousands of mainly Palestinians who've been killed in the conflict.
cues.zh: 其余队员佩戴黑色臂章，悼念冲突中丧生的数万名巴勒斯坦人。

cues.en: Before the match, the Israeli football association insisted that politics and sport should remain separate.
cues.zh: 赛前，以色列足协坚持认为政治和体育应当分开。

cues.en: Our sports correspondent Kevin Sharkey was at the match and told me more about the drama in the build-up to the game.
cues.zh: 我们的体育记者凯文·沙基在现场，向我介绍了比赛前的这场风波。

cues.en: The lead-up to this match was shrouded in controversy.
cues.zh: 这场比赛的赛前准备笼罩在争议之中。

cues.en: There was a clamour back home in Ireland for the footballers of the Republic of Ireland not to participate in this match.
cues.zh: 爱尔兰国内强烈呼吁爱尔兰共和国队球员不要参加这场比赛。

cues.en: This had gone on for weeks and indeed months beforehand, ever since the two sides were pitted together in this tournament.
cues.zh: 这种呼声持续了数周甚至数月，自两队在本届赛事中被抽到一起后便一直如此。

cues.en: It came to a head on Saturday, when the Republic of Ireland delayed a press conference and training as the players deliberated.
cues.zh: 周六，球员们商议时，爱尔兰共和国队推迟了新闻发布会和训练，争议达到高潮。

cues.en: They ultimately chose to play, but it wasn't easy.
cues.zh: 他们最终选择参赛，但这并不容易。

cues.en: A vote had to be taken among the players.
cues.zh: 队员们必须进行投票。

cues.en: One player left the squad because of the controversy.
cues.zh: 一名球员因这场争议退出了球队。

cues.en: The Republic of Ireland players came out, gave an emphatic performance, and won 3-0.
cues.zh: 爱尔兰共和国队球员表现强势，以3比0获胜。

cues.en: So perhaps from their point of view there will at least be some vindication in their decision to go ahead and play the match.
cues.zh: 因此在他们看来，决定继续参赛至少得到了一些印证。

cues.en: But notwithstanding that, the controversy leading up to this match will not have gone away.
cues.zh: 但即便如此，围绕这场比赛的赛前争议并不会消失。

cues.en: There are still very many fans of the Republic of Ireland who believe they should not be playing Israel under any circumstances.
cues.zh: 仍有许多爱尔兰共和国队球迷认为，无论如何都不应与以色列比赛。

cues.en: Kevin, tell us how the match actually went.
cues.zh: 凯文，请告诉我们比赛实际进行得怎样。

cues.en: Was it tense at times?
cues.zh: 比赛有时紧张吗？

cues.en: That was what was particularly noteworthy about the match.
cues.zh: 这正是比赛特别值得注意之处。

cues.en: There was none of the tension we had leading up to the match.
cues.zh: 比赛中没有赛前那种紧张气氛。

cues.en: In the actual match itself, on the field of play, it was very much a normal football match played in good spirits.
cues.zh: 在球场上，这就是一场在友好气氛中进行的普通足球比赛。

cues.en: There was one particular flashpoint, but it was over almost before it began.
cues.zh: 有一个小小的冲突点，但几乎刚开始就结束了。

cues.en: From a footballing point of view, it was a competitive match.
cues.zh: 从足球角度看，这是一场竞争激烈的比赛。

cues.en: Notwithstanding the fact that the Republic won by three goals to nil, it was played in a good spirit.
cues.zh: 尽管爱尔兰共和国队以三比零获胜，比赛仍在友好气氛中进行。

cues.en: But of course there were matters before the match where some traditional protocols were not adhered to.
cues.zh: 当然，赛前有些传统礼仪并未遵守。

cues.en: The Irish camp bowed their head during the playing of the Israeli national anthem.
cues.zh: 奏响以色列国歌时，爱尔兰队全体低头。

cues.en: There were no handshakes between the captains before the match, and no traditional pennants were exchanged.
cues.zh: 赛前两队队长没有握手，也没有交换传统的队旗。

cues.en: So it was clear that the Irish players, having decided to play the match, still wanted to register their protests.
cues.zh: 显然，爱尔兰球员决定参赛后，仍想表达抗议。

cues.en: They did so before the match and before kick-off.
cues.zh: 他们在赛前、开球前这样做了。

cues.en: And Kevin, the ground itself was relatively empty.
cues.zh: 凯文，球场本身相当空。

cues.en: Was that perhaps due to the controversy surrounding the match?
cues.zh: 这或许是因为围绕比赛的争议吗？

cues.en: The Football Association of Ireland had decided not to sell any tickets for the match, so that ruled out Republic of Ireland supporters.
cues.zh: 爱尔兰足协决定不为比赛售票，因此爱尔兰共和国队球迷无法购票入场。

cues.en: Israel had sold about 150 tickets.
cues.zh: 以色列方面售出了约150张票。

cues.en: But bizarrely, there were also at least a couple of dozen Republic of Ireland fans who somehow found the wherewithal to find tickets.
cues.zh: 但奇怪的是，至少还有二十多名爱尔兰共和国队球迷不知通过什么办法弄到了票。

cues.en: It was quite remarkable because the stands were by and large empty.
cues.zh: 这相当令人惊讶，因为看台基本空无一人。

cues.en: But for the 150 Israeli fans in one small section and then a couple of dozen Irish fans, 50 metres or so apart.
cues.zh: 除了一个小看台区的150名以色列球迷，另一边还有二十多名爱尔兰球迷，两边相距约50米。

cues.en: The small number of Irish fans were making quite a noise, but the Israeli fans were very vociferous in supporting their team.
cues.zh: 爱尔兰球迷人数虽少却很喧闹，以色列球迷支持球队时也声势很大。

cues.en: Kevin Sharkey. Israel and Ireland are set to have a rematch next week.
cues.zh: 凯文·沙基报道：以色列和爱尔兰下周将再度交锋。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast.
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后还有更多内容。

cues.en: There's a very long history continuing up to the present of people who are being politically repressed by the government.
cues.zh: 一段延续至今的漫长历史：人们受到政府政治压制。

cues.en: People move deeper into the forest in order to evade political control.
cues.zh: 人们深入森林，以躲避政治控制。

cues.en: How a book about trees in Russia has picked up a special literary award.
cues.zh: 一本关于俄罗斯树木的书如何获得特别文学奖。

cues.en: This is the Global News podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻》播客。

cues.en: Protests have been held in Caracas and other parts of Venezuela demanding the return of Venezuela's exiled opposition leader Maria Corina Machado.
cues.zh: 加拉加斯和委内瑞拉其他地区举行了抗议活动，要求流亡的委内瑞拉反对派领袖玛丽亚·科丽娜·马查多回国。

cues.en: Well, that is the sound of dozens of motorbikes and cars full of demonstrators waving giant flags and banners in support of Ms Machado.
cues.zh: 这就是数十辆摩托车和汽车的声音，车上挤满了挥舞巨型旗帜和横幅、支持马查多女士的示威者。

cues.en: She left Venezuela secretly nine months ago to accept her Nobel Peace Prize award.
cues.zh: 九个月前，她秘密离开委内瑞拉，去领取诺贝尔和平奖。

cues.en: Her supporters say she's tried seven times to return since then but not been allowed back into the country.
cues.zh: 她的支持者说，自那以后她曾七次尝试回国，但都未获准进入这个国家。

cues.en: So, with elections promised by the country's interim president Delcy Rodriguez, how much broad support is there for Ms Machado to come home?
cues.zh: 那么，随着该国临时总统德尔西·罗德里格斯承诺举行选举，马查多女士回国获得了多大范围的支持？

cues.en: A question I put to our Latin America correspondent Will Grant.
cues.zh: 这是我向拉丁美洲记者威尔·格兰特提出的问题。

cues.en: Protests like this one tell us about two key elements of the complaints of the demonstrators.
cues.zh: 这样的抗议让我们看到示威者诉求中的两个关键要素。

cues.en: The first is, as you say, the support that still exists for Maria Corina Machado.
cues.zh: 第一点，正如你所说，是对玛丽亚·科丽娜·马查多的支持依然存在。

cues.en: The hopes of the opposition supporters in Venezuela are really pretty much solely pinned on her as an individual.
cues.zh: 委内瑞拉反对派支持者的希望，几乎完全寄托在她个人身上。

cues.en: She seems like the person who would be president, and they want to see that happen.
cues.zh: 她似乎就是那个应该成为总统的人，而他们希望看到这件事发生。

cues.en: We've known that she has support, and that support remains.
cues.zh: 我们知道她拥有支持，而且这种支持依然存在。

cues.en: I think that's what that demonstration does.
cues.zh: 我认为，这正是那场示威所表明的。

cues.en: It shows that it is still there.
cues.zh: 它表明这种支持依然存在。

cues.en: But of course, the other thing that it does is show the rejection of Delcy Rodriguez, the interim president,
cues.zh: 当然，这场示威还表明，人们拒绝临时总统德尔西·罗德里格斯，

cues.en: and her burgeoning relationship with Donald Trump.
cues.zh: 也拒绝她与唐纳德·特朗普日益发展的关系。

cues.en: It was no coincidence that Delcy Rodriguez was meeting with Donald Trump
cues.zh: 德尔西·罗德里格斯与唐纳德·特朗普会面，并非巧合，

cues.en: as Maria Corina Machado was unable to return to Venezuela for what we understand were the fifth, sixth and seventh attempts this year.
cues.zh: 因为据我们了解，玛丽亚·科丽娜·马查多今年第五次、第六次和第七次尝试回到委内瑞拉时都未能成功。

cues.en: So she's been attempting via sea, via air; she's constantly turned back.
cues.zh: 所以她一直尝试从海上或空中返回，却不断被挡回去。

cues.en: One thinks, given the key control that Washington continues to exert over Delcy Rodriguez, her administration and Venezuela as a whole,
cues.zh: 有人认为，鉴于华盛顿仍在对德尔西·罗德里格斯、她的政府以及整个委内瑞拉施加关键控制，

cues.en: there's clearly resistance coming from Washington as well as Caracas.
cues.zh: 显然，阻力既来自华盛顿，也来自加拉加斯。

cues.en: And I think that that is partly what these protesters were saying.
cues.zh: 我认为，这也是这些抗议者所表达的部分意思。

cues.en: You know, not only do we want Maria Corina Machado to come home to Venezuela,
cues.zh: 你看，我们不仅希望玛丽亚·科丽娜·马查多回到委内瑞拉，

cues.en: we want an end to this relationship which they see as simply the remnants of the Maduro regime
cues.zh: 我们还希望终结这种关系；他们认为，这不过是马杜罗政权的残余

cues.en: in bed now with the Trump administration.
cues.zh: 如今与特朗普政府勾连在一起。

cues.en: Having said that, there must be people in Venezuela, Will, who see the relative economic stability returning to Venezuela under this relationship
cues.zh: 话虽如此，威尔，委内瑞拉一定有人看到，在这种关系下，委内瑞拉相对的经济稳定正在回归，

cues.en: between Delcy Rodriguez and President Trump and say, 'Well, this is the situation. We don't want to rock the boat now.'
cues.zh: 他们会说：‘好吧，情况就是这样。我们现在不想打破平衡。’

cues.en: I think you are right. I think the problem is, though, that that pragmatism perhaps comes from a sense of stability, not necessarily economic stability,
cues.zh: 我认为你说得对。不过问题在于，这种务实态度或许源于一种稳定感，而不一定是经济稳定，

cues.en: because the country's economy is still in difficulties. It's not fixed yet,
cues.zh: 因为这个国家的经济仍陷于困境，问题尚未解决，

cues.en: but there is more calm in the international relationship with the most powerful nation in the hemisphere. Things feel more stable,
cues.zh: 但与这个半球最强大国家的国际关系更加平静，局势感觉更稳定，

cues.en: less prone to some of these shocking moments that Venezuelans have been through this year.
cues.zh: 不太容易再出现委内瑞拉人今年经历过的那些震惊时刻。

cues.en: Now, several days ago in New York at the United Nations, Delcy Rodriguez promised elections.
cues.zh: 几天前，德尔西·罗德里格斯在纽约联合国承诺举行选举。

cues.en: She didn't say when they would take place.
cues.zh: 但她没有说选举何时举行。

cues.en: What is your assessment as to when and if that will happen?
cues.zh: 你认为这会在何时发生，或者是否会发生？

cues.en: It's hard to read that one, isn't it?
cues.zh: 这很难判断，不是吗？

cues.en: My feeling is that this is simply something that the Trump administration needs to now be bringing to bear on Delcy Rodriguez and her administration.
cues.zh: 我的感觉是，特朗普政府现在必须把这件事施加给德尔西·罗德里格斯及其政府。

cues.en: They can't simply continue to work with her with absolutely no movement towards free and fair elections
cues.zh: 他们不能在完全没有朝自由公正选举迈进的情况下，继续与她合作，

cues.en: as pushed for by the diaspora community in Florida, which are so influential in terms of Donald Trump's support
cues.zh: 而佛罗里达州的侨民团体一直推动这样的选举，他们对唐纳德·特朗普在该州获得的支持影响很大，

cues.en: in that state and more broadly.
cues.zh: 不仅在该州如此，更广泛地说也是如此。

cues.en: The Trump administration has sent in troops to remove Nicolas Maduro from power and seems so comfortable working with his vice president
cues.zh: 特朗普政府派兵推翻尼古拉斯·马杜罗，并且似乎很自在地与他的副总统合作，

cues.en: that only gets them so far.
cues.zh: 但这只能让他们走到这一步。

cues.en: I think, and Marco Rubio, the Secretary of State, has been quite clear about that.
cues.zh: 我认为，国务卿马可·卢比奥对此已经说得很清楚。

cues.en: They've basically said, look, they don't consider Venezuela to be ready yet.
cues.zh: 他们基本上是说，委内瑞拉还没有准备好。

cues.en: As Donald Trump put it, ultimately Delcy Rodriguez and the Trump administration have to get it to a point eventually
cues.zh: 正如唐纳德·特朗普所说，最终德尔西·罗德里格斯和特朗普政府必须让局势发展到一个阶段，

cues.en: where those elections will take place. We don't yet know whether Delcy Rodriguez would be a candidate in them.
cues.zh: 让选举得以举行。我们还不知道德尔西·罗德里格斯是否会参选。

cues.en: We don't know if Maria Corina Machado will be able to get back for them and be a candidate.
cues.zh: 我们不知道玛丽亚·科丽娜·马查多能否赶回去参加选举并成为候选人。

cues.en: But I think we've seen all of the context around this is the huge energy deal between Washington and Venezuela
cues.zh: 但我认为，我们已经看到这一切背后的全部背景：华盛顿与委内瑞拉之间那项巨大的能源协议，

cues.en: to the tune of 65 billion barrels of oil.
cues.zh: 规模相当于650亿桶石油。

cues.en: So of course the Trump administration continues to be quite comfortable working with Delcy Rodriguez under those terms.
cues.zh: 所以，当然，特朗普政府在这些条件下继续与德尔西·罗德里格斯合作，感到相当自在。

cues.en: But Venezuelans are beginning to really clamor for the opportunity to choose their own country's leadership.
cues.zh: 但委内瑞拉人开始强烈要求获得选择本国领导人的机会。

cues.en: Will Grant.
cues.zh: 威尔·格兰特报道。

cues.en: Two mass shootings in South Africa have left 27 people dead.
cues.zh: 南非发生两起大规模枪击事件，造成27人死亡。

cues.en: Seventeen were killed when eight gunmen stormed a bar close to Johannesburg on Saturday night.
cues.zh: 周六夜间，八名枪手闯入约翰内斯堡附近一家酒吧，造成17人死亡。

cues.en: Then, in the early hours of Sunday, ten people died in another shooting outside an entertainment venue near Cape Town.
cues.zh: 随后在周日凌晨，开普敦附近一家娱乐场所外发生另一起枪击，10人死亡。

cues.en: Dozens were wounded in the two shootings. The motive is not yet known,
cues.zh: 两起枪击共造成数十人受伤。动机尚不清楚，

cues.en: but South Africa has a huge problem with gang-related gun violence and a very high murder rate.
cues.zh: 但南非帮派相关枪支暴力问题严重，谋杀率也非常高。

cues.en: The BBC's Thomas McWana gave us more details about these shootings.
cues.zh: BBC记者托马斯·姆夸纳介绍了这些枪击的更多详情。

cues.en: The one in Johannesburg occurred in a tavern, and it said that eight gunmen in two vehicles
cues.zh: 约翰内斯堡的枪击发生在一家小酒馆。据说八名枪手乘坐两辆车，

cues.en: came out and shot at people outside the venue and then also entered and shot people inside.
cues.zh: 下车向场所外的人开枪，随后又进入场所内向人群开枪。

cues.en: And after taking the cell phones that they had, they escaped in those two unidentified vehicles.
cues.zh: 他们拿走受害者的手机后，乘坐那两辆身份不明的车辆逃走。

cues.en: And in Cape Town, there was an entertainment event happening, and they entered the venue
cues.zh: 在开普敦，当时一场娱乐活动正在举行，他们进入场所，

cues.en: and a similar shooting occurred, killing ten and injuring many more.
cues.zh: 随后发生类似枪击，造成10人死亡、更多人受伤。

cues.en: South Africa has one of the highest murder rates in the world.
cues.zh: 南非拥有世界上最高的谋杀率之一。

cues.en: Just between April and June this year, South African police said over 5,400 people have been murdered.
cues.zh: 仅今年4月至6月，南非警方就说有超过5400人被谋杀。

cues.en: Being murdered, a matter of malicious intent.
cues.zh: 谋杀本身就是出于恶意的犯罪。

cues.en: And then it compounds when you realize that the murder rates and the conviction rates
cues.zh: 而当你意识到谋杀率和案件侦查后的定罪率

cues.en: for investigations are much lower. So the investigations that lead to actual conviction for people who are murdered are much lower,
cues.zh: 都低得多时，问题就更加严重。针对谋杀案、最终真正定罪的调查比例也低得多，

cues.en: and that means basically justice isn't served to the victims of such shootings.
cues.zh: 这基本意味着，这类枪击案的受害者无法得到公正。

cues.en: And South Africa is awash with illegal weapons and gang activity that the police there have found hard to end.
cues.zh: 南非还充斥着非法武器和帮派活动，当地警方一直难以遏制。

cues.en: Thomas McWana.
cues.zh: 托马斯·姆夸纳报道。

cues.en: A book about the centrality of the forest in Russian culture has won a prestigious British literary award.
cues.zh: 一本关于森林在俄罗斯文化中核心地位的书，赢得了一项英国著名文学奖。

cues.en: The Pushkin House Book Prize was given to Sophie Pinkham's book,
cues.zh: 普希金之家图书奖授予了苏菲·平克姆的著作：

cues.en: The Oak and the Larch: A Forest History of Russia and Its Empires.
cues.zh: 《橡树与落叶松：俄罗斯及其帝国的森林史》。

cues.en: There are lots of references to trees in Russian literature, from the gnarled oak in Tolstoy's War and Peace to Pushkin's reflections on pines.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯文学中有许多关于树木的描写，从托尔斯泰《战争与和平》里的盘曲橡树，到普希金对松树的感悟。

cues.en: But this prize is for the best nonfiction writing on Russia in the English language.
cues.zh: 但这个奖项颁给的是英语世界关于俄罗斯的最佳非虚构作品。

cues.en: Owen Bennett Jones asked Sophie Pinkham why she found the theme of Russian forests so interesting that she wanted to write a book about them.
cues.zh: 欧文·贝内特-琼斯询问苏菲·平克姆，为什么她觉得俄罗斯森林这一主题如此有趣，以至于想写一本相关的书。

cues.en: Well, I am a specialist in Russia, to some extent Ukraine, and the former Soviet Union—former Russian imperial territory.
cues.zh: 我研究俄罗斯，也在一定程度上研究乌克兰，以及前苏联和昔日俄罗斯帝国的领土。

cues.en: I started thinking back to all of the ways that forests appear in Russian literature.
cues.zh: 我开始回想森林在俄罗斯文学中出现的各种方式。

cues.en: So I'm primarily a specialist in literature and film, and I began to realize how absolutely
cues.zh: 我主要研究文学和电影，后来开始意识到，森林是如此彻底地——

cues.en: the forest was not only central to Russia's historical and political development, but also to its, we could say, national imagination,
cues.zh: 森林不仅是俄罗斯历史和政治发展的核心，也可以说，是俄罗斯民族想象的核心。

cues.en: sort of standing for fear, but also a sense of home and protection, for kind of nourishment and riches.
cues.zh: 它某种程度上象征着恐惧，也象征着家的感觉和保护，象征着滋养与财富。

cues.en: And also as a place from which Russian culture had arisen.
cues.zh: 也是俄罗斯文化由此生发的地方。

cues.en: The way that I structured my book, The Oak and the Larch, was as a kind of an alternative history of Russia before there even was a Russia.
cues.zh: 我构思《橡树与落叶松》这本书的方式，是把它写成一部俄罗斯尚未存在之前的另类俄罗斯史。

cues.en: So when you say it's a source of protection, what do you mean by that?
cues.zh: 你说森林是保护的来源，具体是什么意思？

cues.en: Well, over the centuries, the forests of Russia, which are of course immensely, immensely large even now,
cues.zh: 几个世纪以来，俄罗斯的森林当然一直极其、极其广袤，即使在今天也是如此，

cues.en: and many of them very remote, have often been a place of refuge.
cues.zh: 其中许多还十分偏远，常常成为避难之所。

cues.en: So sometimes they provided a place of refuge from the steppe invaders many centuries ago.
cues.zh: 所以，许多世纪以前，森林有时为人们躲避草原入侵者提供了庇护。

cues.en: Later on, they served as a very important place of escape from political repression.
cues.zh: 后来，森林又成为逃避政治压迫的重要去处。

cues.en: So there's a very long history continuing up to the present
cues.zh: 因此，这段历史延续至今，

cues.en: of people who are being politically repressed by the government
cues.zh: 有些人受到政府的政治压迫，

cues.en: moving deeper into the forest in order to evade political control.
cues.zh: 便深入森林，以躲避政治控制。

cues.en: I think it's fair to say that the communist Soviet period
cues.zh: 我认为可以说，在共产主义苏联时期，

cues.en: there was a policy of conquering nature to some extent. Did that extend to the forests?
cues.zh: 在某种程度上存在征服自然的政策。这种政策也延伸到森林吗？

cues.en: Were the Soviets big on deforestation?
cues.zh: 苏联人大肆砍伐森林吗？

cues.en: Absolutely, there was a moment under Stalin when they even declared a war on the forest.
cues.zh: 当然。斯大林时期曾有一段时间，他们甚至向森林宣战。

cues.en: Yeah, and the Soviet attitude towards nature was indeed as you say: it had to be completely subjugated to human ends.
cues.zh: 是的，苏联对待自然的态度正如你所说：自然必须完全屈从于人类目的。

cues.en: And this is not a uniquely Soviet idea. It's something that appears already in the Book of Genesis.
cues.zh: 这并非苏联独有的观念，《创世记》中早已出现了这种思想。

cues.en: Man is tasked with subjugating nature, but the Soviets, as was their wont, took it to a really extraordinary extreme, rerouting rivers
cues.zh: 人被赋予征服自然的任务，但苏联人一如既往地把它推向了极端，改道河流，

cues.en: e.g. draining seas and also deforesting very intensely.
cues.zh: 例如排干海洋，并大规模砍伐森林。

cues.en: The idea was that any part of nature that wasn't serving the Soviet project,
cues.zh: 当时的想法是，自然中任何不服务于苏联事业的部分，

cues.en: Soviet industrialization was lazy and useless.
cues.zh: 也就是不服务于苏联工业化的部分，都是懒惰而无用的。

cues.en: Yeah, but when Stalin said we've got to get rid of the forest
cues.zh: 是的，但当斯大林说必须消灭森林时，

cues.en: Did people see that at the time? They probably didn't dare say so, but would they have seen it as an attack on the Russian soul?
cues.zh: 当时人们看到了这一点吗？他们可能不敢这样说，但会不会把这看作对俄罗斯灵魂的攻击？

cues.en: Yes, they did see that and actually they did say it. And it's quite remarkable
cues.zh: 是的，他们确实看到了，而且确实说了出来。这非常不寻常，

cues.en: because although Stalin was so repressive, there were a lot of people
cues.zh: 因为尽管斯大林实行高压统治，几十年间仍有许多人

cues.en: who stood up to him. Some of them were foresters actually who opposed his practices and in fact risked their lives in order to try to protect forests.
cues.zh: 站出来反对他。其中一些人其实是林务员，他们反对他的做法，甚至冒着生命危险保护森林。

cues.en: I should add also that under Stalin there was a sort of a strange duality to it
cues.zh: 我还应该补充，斯大林时期这件事存在某种奇怪的两面性，

cues.en: because late in his life Stalin developed this bizarre plan called
cues.zh: 因为斯大林晚年制定了一个奇怪的计划，叫作

cues.en: Stalin's Great Plan for the Transformation of Nature. It was sort of typical Stalinist grandiosity
cues.zh: “斯大林改造自然大计划”。这带有典型的斯大林式宏大狂想，

cues.en: and part of that plan was in fact to plant large numbers of trees in order to protect Russian land
cues.zh: 计划的一部分确实是种植大量树木，保护俄罗斯的土地，

cues.en: from what were imagined as the uncivilized Central Asian steppe winds and therefore thereby help agriculture.
cues.zh: 抵御当时想象中的未开化中亚草原风，从而帮助农业。

cues.en: But there too there was a very strange ideological element to it because at that point
cues.zh: 但其中也有一个非常奇怪的意识形态因素，因为在那时，

cues.en: They were relying on this bogus biological idea that you could even indoctrinate acorns
cues.zh: 他们依赖一种虚假的生物学观念，认为甚至可以向橡果灌输思想，

cues.en: to build these communist walls of trees. Sophie Pinkham.
cues.zh: 让它们筑起这样的共产主义树墙。以上是苏菲·平克姆的介绍。

cues.en: To the United States now, where the famous Route 66 turns a hundred this year.
cues.zh: 现在来到美国，这里著名的66号公路今年迎来百年。

cues.en: The highway weaves its way through towns all the way from Chicago to Los Angeles.
cues.zh: 这条公路蜿蜒穿过沿途城镇，从芝加哥一路通往洛杉矶。

cues.en: And helped create the classic American roadside economy with all its diners, neon signs, and quirky motels.
cues.zh: 它还帮助塑造了美国经典的公路沿线经济：餐馆、霓虹招牌和风格各异的汽车旅馆。

cues.en: But a century after it first captured our imagination, does the ultimate American road trip, which is also known as the Mother Road, still have the same pull?
cues.zh: 但在它首次俘获我们的想象力一个世纪后，这场被称为“母亲之路”的终极美国公路旅行，是否仍有同样的吸引力？

cues.en: Victoria Craig headed west across the United States to discover whether nostalgia is still drawing tourists and their dollars to towns along the route.
cues.zh: 维多利亚·克雷格向西穿越美国，探寻怀旧情怀是否仍在把游客和他们的钱吸引到沿线城镇。

cues.en: Route 66 is a 2,500-mile stretch of concrete and pavement that runs from the bustling metropolis of Chicago, Illinois,
cues.zh: 66号公路是一段长达2500英里的混凝土和路面，从伊利诺伊州繁华的大都市芝加哥出发，

cues.en: all the way to the sandy West Coast shores of Santa Monica, California.
cues.zh: 一路延伸至加利福尼亚州圣莫尼卡的西海岸沙滩。

cues.en: Our first stop is in Cuba, Missouri, and the Wagon Wheel Hotel.
cues.zh: 我们的第一站是密苏里州的古巴镇，以及瓦贡轮酒店。

cues.en: Hi.
cues.zh: 嗨。

cues.en: It's been operating here for more than 90 years.
cues.zh: 它在这里营业已经超过90年。

cues.en: It's where we meet Roamin' Rich Dinkela, a lifelong Route 66 enthusiast.
cues.zh: 我们在这里遇到了“漫游者”里奇·丁克拉，一位终身热爱66号公路的人。

cues.en: He bought this historic Mother Road property, which is his second, in April this year.
cues.zh: 他今年4月买下了这处历史悠久的“母亲之路”房产，这是他买下的第二处房产。

cues.en: This place represents so much.
cues.zh: 这个地方承载着太多意义。

cues.en: You've got the Ozark stone cottages, and people can come here.
cues.zh: 这里有欧扎克石屋，人们可以来到这里。

cues.en: They can get a glimpse of what it was like in the 30s and 40s.
cues.zh: 他们可以一窥这里在20世纪30年代和40年代是什么样子。

cues.en: Do you worry if there isn't more awareness raised,
cues.zh: 你是否担心，如果没有更多人提高意识，

cues.en: particularly for younger generations who will eventually be the ones staying in this motel and others?
cues.zh: 尤其是年轻一代，他们最终会住在这家及其他汽车旅馆里？

cues.en: I've been extremely worried about the centennial that we're going to see a lot of bad decisions, and we have.
cues.zh: 我一直非常担心这次百年纪念，我们将会看到许多糟糕的决定，而事实确实如此。

cues.en: Several hours west in Clinton, Oklahoma.
cues.zh: 在俄克拉何马州克林顿以西几小时车程处，

cues.en: There's been a boom in visitors to the city's Route 66 Museum.
cues.zh: 这座城市的66号公路博物馆迎来了一波游客热潮。

cues.en: The centennial gives us an opportunity to put our story back into a national conversation.
cues.zh: 百年纪念给了我们一个机会，让我们的故事重新进入全国性的讨论。

cues.en: That's museum director Corey Cart.
cues.zh: 这是博物馆馆长科里·卡特。

cues.en: Sales in our gift shop are up over 300%.
cues.zh: 我们礼品店的销售额增长了超过300%。

cues.en: We're also celebrating America's 250th, and that is giving us a chance to tell the story to audiences
cues.zh: 我们也在庆祝美国建国250周年，这让我们有机会向一些观众讲述这个故事，

cues.en: that before have never considered Route 66.
cues.zh: 他们过去从未想过要了解66号公路。

cues.en: Indeed, Oklahoma's relationship to the Mother Road runs deep.
cues.zh: 的确，俄克拉何马州与“母亲之路”的渊源十分深厚。

cues.en: Kansas and other states look like moonscapes after huge dark clouds.
cues.zh: 在巨大的乌云过后，堪萨斯州和其他州看起来像月球表面。

cues.en: During the depths of the Great Depression in the 1930s, an environmental disaster known as the Dust Bowl swept through America's southern plains.
cues.zh: 在20世纪30年代大萧条最严重的时期，一场名为“沙尘暴”的环境灾难席卷了美国南部平原。

cues.en: Tenant farmers, pushed deep into poverty by severe drought and rapid agricultural modernization, were forced off their land.
cues.zh: 佃农因严重干旱和农业快速现代化而陷入赤贫，被迫离开自己的土地。

cues.en: Many of them went west along Route 66, searching for a better life in California, but they faced bitter class prejudice and hostility every step of the way.
cues.zh: 他们中的许多人沿66号公路向西前往加州寻找更好的生活，但一路都遭遇了尖锐的阶级偏见和敌意。

cues.en: The early days of Route 66 are not a fun story.
cues.zh: 66号公路的早期历史并不是一个轻松的故事。

cues.en: Where people really want to talk about it is that post-war, that open road represented freedom, and Route 66 just kept reinventing itself.
cues.zh: 人们真正想谈的是战后时期：那条开放的公路代表自由，而66号公路也一直在自我革新。

cues.en: So how important now is Route 66 to Clinton's economy, would you say?
cues.zh: 那么，你会说如今66号公路对克林顿的经济有多重要？

cues.en: If you look at the amount of restaurants and gift shops and things here in town,
cues.zh: 如果看看镇上餐馆、礼品店和其他店铺的数量，

cues.en: that are either named after Route 66 or sell Route 66 souvenirs, it is a huge part of it.
cues.zh: 它们要么以66号公路命名，要么出售66号公路纪念品，可见这条公路是这里的重要组成部分。

cues.en: Lightning McQueen, the famous race car.
cues.zh: 闪电麦坤，这辆著名的赛车。

cues.en: Pixar's 2006 animated hit Cars captured the nostalgia of the 1950s-era road trip culture for a new generation.
cues.zh: 皮克斯2006年的动画热门电影《赛车总动员》，让新一代感受到了20世纪50年代公路旅行文化的怀旧情怀。

cues.en: Research from the National Travel Center Organization shows the power of heritage tourism.
cues.zh: 国家旅行中心组织的研究显示了遗产旅游的力量。

cues.en: It found that secondary roads like Route 66,
cues.zh: 研究发现，像66号公路这样的次要公路，

cues.en: if promoted, can drive up to $450,000 in visitor spending per mile each year.
cues.zh: 如果加以推广，每英里每年最多可以带来45万美元的游客消费。

cues.en: That's around $280,000 per kilometer.
cues.zh: 这相当于每公里约28万美元。

cues.en: Though for remote stretches of road, capturing even a fraction of that is still a constant battle.
cues.zh: 不过，对于偏远路段来说，即使获得其中一小部分收益，仍是一场持续的战斗。

cues.en: Victoria Craig.
cues.zh: 维多利亚·克雷格。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 以上就是本期节目的全部内容。

cues.zh: 如果你想联系我们，可以发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.zh: 你也可以在X平台通过BBC World Service找到我们。请使用话题标签GlobalNewsPod。

cues.zh: 本期《全球新闻播客》由德里克·克拉克混音，艾玛·约瑟夫制作。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I am Nick Miles, and until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 我是尼克·迈尔斯，我们下期再见。
